gripOrHq.title: Mantis, Fixer-at-Large
gripOrHq.rulesText: Search your stack for a card, and bring it into your hand. Reshuffle your stack afterwards.

gripOrHq.title: Wilson, Weeflerunner Apprentice
gripOrHq.rulesText:
Each of your turns, you may choose to gain an action, which you may use only to make a run. You cannot spend more than [3] during that run to pay for using icebreakers or increasing your link. Use this ability only once per turn and only during your turn.
[T]: Avoid receiving a tag.
[T]: Prevent any amount of meat damage.

gripOrHq.title: Inside Job
gripOrHq.rulesText: Make a run. You automatically pass the first piece of ice you encounter during that run.

rig.title: Zetatech Software Installer
rig.rulesText: Put [2] bits on Software Installer when it is installed. Use these bits only to pay for installing programs. You may use these bits to install a program overwriting Software Installer itself. If you use any of these bits, replace them at the start of your next turn.

root.title: Turbeau Delacroix
root.rulesText: Trace 10-If trace is successful, give Runner a tag. Use this ability only when Runner accesses Turbeau Delacroix, and only once during each run on this fort.

ice.title: Data Raven
ice.rulesText: [Subroutine] Trace 5 - If trace is successful, give Runner a tag and a Data Raven counter. Each Data Raven counter gives Runner a tag at the start of each Runner turn. Runner may remove a Data Raven counter by taking an action to pay [1].

root.title: Omniscience Foundation
root.rulesText: Give Runner a tag at the end of each turn during which Runner received a tag.

root.title: City Surveillance
root.rulesText: For each card Runner draws, give Runner a tag unless Runner pays [1], in addition to any other costs, to avoid receiving that tag. You may rez City Surveillance just before the card is drawn.
